method.identity: Unique own-item nondeprecated Census P590/P774; row, item and Census names and state agree; stable 2010/2024 GNIS/GEOID/name plus invariant v4.0 name/state/item or exact 2010 count. No coordinate input to identity proof.
method.points: Copy 2024 Gazetteer INTPTLAT/INTPTLONG to existing 8-decimal strings only. Census US federal public-domain work, 17 USC 105.
method.geometry: Original undissolved TIGERweb ACS2024; invalid geometry uses make_valid polygon components only, with both repair area change and ellipsoidal area discrepancy from Gazetteer ALAND+AWATER <2%. Old point outside by >500m; 1m uncertainty band held; new point must be covered.
method.distance: WGS84 geodesic movement. Outside distance: AEQD centred at old point, edges densified to <=0.001 degrees before projection; radial boundary distance.
method.candidate_universe: Every current US row screened against same-name/state and own-item-coded Census places/active MCDs; union all #2075 suspected-point/status conflicts and all 120 #2089 valid outside-own-polygon rows. Same-name GNIS populated places within 500m of the old point veto a move when absent from own-item P590 or outside the bound MCD scope. Puerto Rico unchanged.
